children: Temple & Webster still warrants caution ahead of what Bell Potter analyst Chami Ratnapala thinks will be a challenging seasonal trading period. With an unchanged hold rating on the stock, Ratnapala sees positive signs of revenue growth and contribution margin in the furniture retailer's latest trading update. However, she points out in a note that the company's current cash position is unclear and that she expects trade over the last 10 or 11 weeks of the December half to be challenging. The company is navigating a declining revenue environment for most of its current fiscal year, she adds. Bell Potter raises its target price by 11% to 5.00 Australian dollars. Shares are down 1.6% at A$4.97. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
